title: Federal Reserve Holds Benchmark Interest Rate Steady Amid Inflation Moderation
text: WASHINGTON (Reuters) - The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Wednesday following a two-day monetary policy meeting. Policymakers noted that while inflation has eased notably over the past year, it remains somewhat elevated above the central bank's two percent target. Economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace, supported by resilient consumer spending and a stable labor market. Fed officials indicated that future adjustments will depend on incoming economic data and ongoing risk assessments.

Participating delegations agreed to establish transparent monitoring mechanisms to track emissions reductions across industrialized and developing economies.

title: European Central Bank Signals Measured Approach to Future Policy Adjustments

title: International Maritime Organization Adopts Stricter Vessel Emission Reduction Targets
